ev.q: The percentage of adults with current hepatitis C virus infection was greater among those with no insurance (1.7%) or public insurance (1.4%), compared with those with private insurance (0.3%).
an estimated 0.9% of U.S. adults aged ≥18 years had current hepatitis C virus infection
was greater among those with no insurance (1.7%) or public insurance (1.4%), compared with those with private insurance (0.3%).
Based on a representative sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.
Source: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey, January 2017–March 2020.

methods_quotes.q: With 95% CIs indicated by error bars.
Data collected during January 2019–March 2020 were combined with data from the 2017–2018 NHANES
Current hepatitis C virus infection was based on the detection of viral RNA in serum.
